{"reason":"Replace the medium/high fallback action with alert-planner: it costs 35,000 versus 45,000 and always arrives on time. All 34 supplier switches therefore save at least 340,000, with no stockout increase; this also fixes the medium 5.3- and 2.8-day rows that each incurred a stockout and 195,000 cost.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
          (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
